The '''1983 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 38th season of the [[Danish 1st Division]] league championship, governed by the [[Danish Football Association]]. It constituted the 70th edition of the [[Danish football champions]]hip, and saw [[Lyngby Boldklub]] win their first championship title.

The Danish champions qualified for the [[European Cup 1984-85]] qualification, while the second and third placed teams qualified for the qualification round of the [[UEFA Cup 1984-85]]. The three lowest placed teams of the tournament were directly [[Promotion and relegation|relegated]] to the [[Danish 2nd Division]] for the following season. Likewise, the Danish 2nd Division champions and two first runners-up were [[promotion and relegation|promoted]] to the 1st Division.
